package.name: cli11
package.title: CLI11 command line parser
package.description: Header-only C++ CLI parser. Built in this project so Leap 16.1 quickshell is not blocked on openSUSE Backports cli11-devel rebuilds. Debian already has libcli11-dev. Built per-arch (not noarch) so OBS does not stall dependents waiting for identical noarch RPMs across workers.
